enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Remain motionless. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Stretch legs. Remain motionless. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Continue sleeping.

Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up soap. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and cereal box. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet. Open drawer. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close drawer. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check phone. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Insert card into fare box. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to office building.

enriched_activities.activity: Coordinating community programs at nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Greet colleague: 'Good morning.' Walk to desk. Sit down. Press power button on computer. Open email application. Read emails. Type replies. Pick up phone. Call community partner. Discuss event logistics. Write notes. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Update database. Print documents. File documents.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose sandwich. Choose fruit. Place on tray. Pay cashier. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Eat fruit. Drink water. Talk with colleague. Stand up. Pick up tray. Return tray to rack. Walk out of cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Coordinating community programs at nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Return to desk. Sit down. Open project plan. Review budget. Make phone calls. Attend meeting. Take notes. Update spreadsheet. Send emails. Print report. File report. Organize files. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Stand up. Walk to copier. Make copies. Return to desk. Sit down. Continue working.

Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait. Board bus. Insert card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Close cabinet. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Chop vegetables. Put vegetables in pan. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add salt. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

Pick up plates from table. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Rinse cloth. Wipe stove. Rinse cloth. Wipe table. Rinse cloth. Put cloth in sink.

Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Stretch legs. Remain still. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Continue sleeping.
